verdict.rationale: RingCentral has first-party automation capabilities: a no-code Workflow Builder, an Agentic Voice AI platform pitched to automate customer interactions end-to-end, an AI Receptionist that answers and routes calls on its own, and rule-based call handling. Each is only a one-line marketing or nav mention, so there is no detail on how user-defined automations are triggered, scheduled or run unattended. missing for 10: documentation of Workflow Builder triggers/actions and background execution, evidence that users can define their own autonomous AI-agent workflows beyond prebuilt receptionist/routing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
